summary.text: Lora Covrett is the Democratic candidate for Ohio House of Representatives District 87 in the November 3, 2026 general election.
In a Ballotpedia survey, Covrett described herself as an IT consultant and listed protecting property rights, opposing data centers on rural farmland, and property taxes as her key messages.

paragraphs.text: Lora Covrett graduated from Olentangy High School and earned a bachelor's degree from DeVry University in 1998, and her career experience includes working as an IT consultant.
In a Ballotpedia survey, Covrett said she began her career in fast food, where she became a manager at age eighteen.
Covrett advanced from the Democratic primary on May 5, 2026 as a write-in candidate.
She said in the survey that she opposes the US 23/I-71 corridor study and the use of eminent domain to benefit private interests.
She also said she wants to diagnose why property taxes have grown so high and propose fixes rather than abolish them.
